images.seen: Start anchor looks right: Rome with Britain and Anatolia, Parthia, Kushan block, Han with Liaodong, Xianbei over the steppe, Dacian kingdom still free; no strays or speckle.

Warlord map matches the pages (Liu Zhang, Liu Biao, Sun Ce, Yuan Shao, Cao Cao, Han Sui, Gongsun Liaodong); Cliopatria still draws one Han empire. Faults: Tarim still painted as the protectorate in 184-199, northern Jiangsu (Xu Province) grey; Yuan Shao, Liu Biao and Gongsun Liaodong share one colour.

Trajan's conquests are given back as the pages say (occupation ends, Armenia independent, Osroes I land, Adiabene, Hatra); Cliopatria keeps all of it Roman. Only oddity is a small unclaimed patch of Upper Mesopotamia (Tur Abdin side), see issues.
Osroene a Roman vassal, Parthia back on the Tigris, Adiabene and Hatra Parthian vassals; correct. The grey patch north of Adiabene (60 to 99 cells, 118-159) is a gap with no event.

India and Central Asia agree with Cliopatria apart from deliberate corrections (Kuninda and Chutu drawn, Mahameghavahana kept). Han band at the Hami/Dunhuang edge and the protectorate in the Tarim oases are as the dossiers intend.
Tarim empty after 175 as the pages say; Cao Cao now holds northern Jiangsu; nothing else moved.

issues.what: Tarim Basin drawn as Han land 107-116: han-dynasty_106 is meant to hold 106 only but, with no from/to, ran to 116 and was unioned with han-dynasty_107, giving the Han 2,540 Tarim cells although the post was abandoned on 29 July 107 and not restored until 123.

Protectorate redrawn from 117 (shape protectorate_117 had no from/to and ran 117-183) although the dossier says it holds 123-175 only. Tarim now unclaimed 107-122, restored 123-124 and carried to 175 by the Han ledger.

Protectorate shapes 184 and 197 are marked 'wrong' in the dossier but their correction was the shape itself, so the compiler drew 1,833 and 2,370 Tarim cells in 184-199 although no protector or chief official is recorded after 175. Replaced by an empty correction.

The dossier's 176 loss takes only 944 cells, leaving 1,351 Tarim cells to the protectorate for 176-199 (Han ledger 82 hands it 2,295 cells at 125). Added a 176 loss of the whole Tarim and Turfan-Hami.

Xu Province (northern Jiangsu, about 340 cells) was nobody's land throughout the 190s; the page says Xu Province came under Cao Cao's control in 198 after Lu Bu's death. Lu Bu, Tao Qian and Liu Bei have no dossiers, so 192-197 stays unclaimed and only the 198 gain is added.

Tarim 125-175 is held by the protectorate with 2,295 cells (Han ledger 82's vassal_end hands the Tarim and Turfan-Hami cells of the 106 shape to the vassal), while the protectorate dossier means its 944-cell Cliopatria oasis shape. The pages are silent on the extent in 125-175.

Yuan Shu holds 1,038 Anhui and Jiangsu cells in 191 (han-dynasty ledger 90, from the End of the Han 191 list) and loses them at the 192 snap; his own dossier has Nanyang to 192 and the Huai country from 193 (about 290 cells). One year and a dossier disagreement; the page also says c. 200 he held 'most of present-day Anhui and parts of Jiangsu', larger than his 193 shape.
Xianbei confederation breaks up in 197 and 18,345 cells of the steppe go to nobody (xianbei ledger 7).
Han and Xianbei both claim about 105 Inner Mongolian cells in 106-154 (Xianbei wins as the smaller) and the Hami disc in 151-165; both dossiers flag the Cliopatria shapes as unverified.

Kangju beats Kushan and Parthia, and Kuninda beats Kushan, on the size rule (about 1,000 cell-years each) in Tashkent, Ferghana, Bukhara and the Himalayan foothills; plausible as enclaves and no page opened contradicts it.
Upper Mesopotamia north of Adiabene (Tur Abdin and Arzanene side, 60 to 99 cells) is nobody's land from 118 to 159, Roman in Cliopatria; no event explains it and no page opened places it.
Contest 'Jewish rebels of Judaea' (Bar Kokhba, 132-135) has 0 cells because the rebels have no dossier.

problems: Systematic: several keyframe_review entries say 'holds N only' or 'holds A-B' in their text but carry no from/to, so the compiler uses the shapes.csv range and unions them with the next keyframe (han-dynasty_106, han-dynasty_117 'holds 119-122 and 125' ran 117-153, protectorate_117). Other windows may show the same overlap; each needs its own keyframe_overrides with from/to.
The Cao Cao gain of Xu Province in 198 carries into p0200-p0299; the End of the Han page says Liu Bei seized Xu Province in early 200, which belongs to that window.
The 107-116 and 176-199 Tarim fixes also lift the Kushan claim over western Tarim cells (han-dynasty / kushan-empire shows 130 cell-years in 1 year in the trial); no action taken.
